text:
🚨 Syria has confirmed it is sending military forces to Saudi Arabia to join the fight against the Houthis, reports say.

Syrian reconnaissance teams had already visited Saudi Arabia and Yemen ahead of a possible deployment. https://t.co/sLVxNiIZnM

Follow up: The Eilat quake was a magnitude 4.5 in the Gulf of Eilat, Israel's Geological Institute says.

Ramon Airport was evacuated, takeoffs were frozen and an Arkia plane was kept in the air. Damage was minor, mostly broken glass. https://t.co/uoO0SSNqKV

Follow up: Iran's Mohsen Rezaei says Tehran has told its "Russian friends" that its enriched nuclear material is staying in Iran.

He says Iran will use it itself, including to design nuclear powered ships and submarines. https://t.co/K7Hy67Gb1W

Iran's PGSA says two bulk carriers used forged documents to sail through Hormuz toward southern Gulf ports without its clearance.

Both faced enforcement action but were kept off its non compliance list after agreeing to follow PGSA directives. https://t.co/clYjO8oASQ

Follow up: India's shipping minister has named the ADNOC tanker hit in the Gulf on 10 November.

It is the Liberia flagged VLCC Fujairah Energy, and four of its crew members were injured in the strike.

🚨 Houthis say they chased Saudi jets away from Sanaa.

Yemen's Ansarallah says its forces fired a surface to air missile at a Saudi F 15 formation, blocking it from the capital's airspace and forcing it to turn back.

🚨 Earthquake alert in southern Israel.

Sirens sounded in Eilat and the surrounding area as the Home Front Command activated its quake warning. No word yet on the magnitude or any damage.

Iran's top security official Mohsen Rezaei draws a hard line on the nuclear file.

"We will not allow even a single particle of enriched nuclear material to leave Iran," he says, according to Al Mayadeen.

Follow up: Bilal Erdogan, son of Turkey's president, is expected to stop in Tripoli and other Sunni strongholds during his planned Lebanon visit.

Southern Lebanon may also be on his route, and Hezbollah and Amal are reported to welcome his arrival.

China 🇨🇳: Flight trackers are picking up a rare cluster of PLA Air Force Y 20 heavy airlifters flying at the same time.

Most of the big transports are over western China, near Xinjiang and Gansu. Why so many at once is not yet clear. https://t.co/9Rt4cVJeOr

Follow up: Iraq is speeding up DNA tests and the handover of former MP Ahmed al Alwani's body, its ambassador in Beirut says.

He adds that suspicion surrounds the people who escorted Alwani from his hotel to the apartment where he was killed.

Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian accuses Washington of a disgraceful double game.

He says the US went to war claiming to stop an Iranian bomb, fired the PrSM missile at Lamerd for the first time, and now waves the "Mother of All Bombs" while talking diplomacy.

Neria Leiter, son of Israel's ambassador to the US, has been moved from Shaare Zedek hospital to a neurological rehabilitation center.

Critically wounded in a ramming attack at a Route 443 checkpoint in September, he remains unconscious but breathes on his own. https://t.co/IUtY0d5laG

Ukraine, Russia and the United States sat down for four hours of peace talks in the Gulf, and Zelensky called the opening day constructive. Washington says the gaps have narrowed, but Donetsk is still the sticking point.

https://t.co/aItMhiu4XJ

QatarEnergy has lost its first known long term LNG contract after Iranian strikes on Ras Laffan.

Poland's Orlen cancelled an oil linked deal for 1 million tonnes a year running to 2034, citing the ongoing force majeure. It keeps its second Qatari contract.

Follow up: Iran's army says the ship seen burning in the Strait of Hormuz caught fire after it tried to cross the strait illegally.

The vessel's name has still not been given, and there is no independent confirmation of the army's statement.

Philippines 🇵🇭: Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) members posted videos from the Bangsamoro region showing off two US made Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR rifles.

The rifles are fitted with Sage EBR chassis, camo wraps and Discovery MS scopes. https://t.co/MlfX5kzf86

Israel's Rafael has unveiled Super Ice, a long range cruise missile with a 1,000 pound warhead that can be fired from jets, ships or ground launchers.

Its range is undisclosed. Rafael's earlier Ice Breaker carried a 250 pound warhead up to 300 km.

Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Marco Rubio is repeating Mike Pompeo's 2018 line that Iranians must obey the White House "if they want to eat".

He says Rubio's fellow Cubans suffer the same policy and blames US "delusions" for its failure.

🚨 Iran has designated Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organizations, its Foreign Ministry says.

Tehran calls it a reciprocal move after Argentina listed the IRGC as a terrorist group in April, and says Buenos Aires is responsible for any consequences.
